caption: The drawing consists of multiple objects and diagrams related to a pocket watch. In the upper left corner, there is a large, colored depiction of a gold pocket watch with a white dial. The face of the watch features black Roman numerals, two black watch hands (minute and hour), and a small subdial with its own hand near the 6 o’clock position. Inside the main dial, the name “C. Frodsham King” and “No. 535” are inscribed. The brass-colored case has a winding crown and bow at the right side. Below this watch face, there is a detailed colored drawing of the watch’s movement, revealing intricate gears, screws, bridges, and inscriptions such as “C.FRODSHAM, MAKER, 85, STRAND, LONDON” and additional patent dates. Some screws are blue, and gears are gold. On the right side of the page, there are several black-and-white technical diagrams. At the top right, there is a side and top view of the escapement mechanism. Below these views are three sequential diagrams showing the movement and action of the escapement. The text beside these diagrams explains: "ACTION OF FASOLDT'S ESCAPEMENT PECULIAR IN THAT THE CURB PINS DESCRIBE SOME CURVE, NOT A CIRCLE. WHIPLASH TYPE." Below, there are two uncolored outline drawings showing the watch’s exact size and thickness, with one view from the front and one from the side. At the bottom center, in capital letters, is the name "HARRY G. ABERDEEN." The background is a plain beige color, and the colored illustrations are noted to be "½ LARGER THAN ACTUAL SIZE."
title: Watch and Case
